import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(14, 10))

# Create a 2x2 grid of scatter plots showing relationships between all features
features = ['sepal_length', 'sepal_width', 'petal_length', 'petal_width']
species = df['species'].unique()
colors = {'setosa': '#FF6B6B', 'versicolor': '#4ECDC4', 'virginica': '#45B7D1'}

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))

# Plot 1: Sepal Length vs Sepal Width
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
for sp in species:
    subset = df[df['species'] == sp]
    ax1.scatter(subset['sepal_length'], subset['sepal_width'], 
                alpha=0.7, s=60, label=sp, color=colors[sp])
ax1.set_xlabel('Sepal Length (cm)', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_ylabel('Sepal Width (cm)', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_title('Sepal Length vs Sepal Width', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='Species')

# Plot 2: Petal Length vs Petal Width
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
for sp in species:
    subset = df[df['species'] == sp]
    ax2.scatter(subset['petal_length'], subset['petal_width'], 
                alpha=0.7, s=60, label=sp, color=colors[sp])
ax2.set_xlabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=12)
ax2.set_ylabel('Petal Width (cm)', fontsize=12)
ax2.set_title('Petal Length vs Petal Width', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax2.legend(title='Species')

# Plot 3: Sepal Length vs Petal Length
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
for sp in species:
    subset = df[df['species'] == sp]
    ax3.scatter(subset['sepal_length'], subset['petal_length'], 
                alpha=0.7, s=60, label=sp, color=colors[sp])
ax3.set_xlabel('Sepal Length (cm)', fontsize=12)
ax3.set_ylabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=12)
ax3.set_title('Sepal Length vs Petal Length', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax3.legend(title='Species')

# Plot 4: Sepal Width vs Petal Width
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
for sp in species:
    subset = df[df['species'] == sp]
    ax4.scatter(subset['sepal_width'], subset['petal_width'], 
                alpha=0.7, s=60, label=sp, color=colors[sp])
ax4.set_xlabel('Sepal Width (cm)', fontsize=12)
ax4.set_ylabel('Petal Width (cm)', fontsize=12)
ax4.set_title('Sepal Width vs Petal Width', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax4.legend(title='Species')

# Adjust layout and add overall title
plt.suptitle('Iris Dataset: Feature Relationships by Species', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
